gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that moving a {@link UtcInstant} to an earlier Modified Julian Day, while keeping its nano-of-day unchanged, produces an earlier instant.
ADDED i2: Start from a TAI instant just before the TAI epoch and convert it to UTC.
ADDED i3: Copy the instant onto an earlier Modified Julian Day, keeping the nano-of-day.
ADDED i4: The original (later day) instant must be after the one on the earlier day.
ADDED i5: withModifiedJulianDay preserves the nano-of-day from the original instant.
